entries.title: Isaiah 62:1
segments: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a lamp that burneth.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:2
segments: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory, and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of Jehovah shall name.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:3
segments: Thou shalt also be a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:4
segments: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah; for Jehovah delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:5
segments: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee; and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:6
segments: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem; they shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that are Jehovah's remembrancers, take ye no rest,

entries.title: Isaiah 62:7
segments: and give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:8
segments: Jehovah hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy grain to be food for thine enemies; and foreigners shall not drink thy new wine, for which thou hast labored:

entries.title: Isaiah 62:9
segments: but they that have garnered it shall eat it, and praise Jehovah; and they that have gathered it shall drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:10
segments: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up an ensign for the peoples.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:11
segments: Behold, Jehovah hath proclaimed unto the end of the earth, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:12
segments: And they shall call them The holy people, The redeemed of Jehovah: and thou shalt be called Sought out, A city not forsaken.
